_about: Photographs used on the site, under the Unsplash License or the Pexels License (free; none are Unsplash+ or premium). Credits render on the Sources page and in each image's title attribute, never as captions. rainlane, office and bazar are copied from main.

delivery-van.alt: A man pedals a three-wheeled van loaded high with orange sacks down a quiet street lined with shopfronts.

night-market.alt: Bunches of green bananas hang over a market stall at night while shoppers browse beneath painted signs.

rainlane.alt: A rain-wet lane in Mirpur, Dhaka, in the evening, with a CNG auto-rickshaw at the kerb.

office.alt: An office building in Gulshan, Dhaka, at night, with its floors lit.

bazar.alt: A Dhaka market street under tangled cables, with umbrella stalls and a mosque minaret at the end.
